notes.title: 🕯️ Rune Ark – When the seals break... darkness rises. 🕯️
notes.content:
The castle trembles. Something ancient stirs beneath the stone — something that was never meant to return. And you… you’re the last flicker of light where hope is already fading.

Rune Ark blends grimdark fantasy with RPG depth, Match-3 combat, and narrative-driven choices. Every decision leaves a scar. Every fight is survival. Every path pulls you deeper — toward truth, or madness.

New update before Steam Next Fest:
• 13 monsters – 13 nightmares.
Each enemy has its own theme, style, and story. These aren’t just battles — they’re chapters written in blood.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208833/f9eeffd9c4d22d6a51f5f822dd1241dc950cc926.png

• 40+ items and 30 crafting recipes.
Weapons laced with runes, cursed elixirs, artifacts forged in desperation. Crafting isn’t optional — it’s how you survive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208833/8ddfd616cce360060afd6993cb92b655c65eeaab.png

• 8 endings in the prologue alone.
Your choices matter from the very first steps. Die noble — or live with what you’ve done.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208833/48e74965e197e0f150356a5b5ac63de089a5d8e5.png

• Companions by choice — or necessity.
– Kaelen: A cold-blooded killer. He doesn’t talk. He acts.
– Serenna: A healer of light. She’ll stand between you and death without hesitation.
Their presence changes more than combat — it changes your story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208833/53601ed421e725a9a899a06e458849183fa594ae.png

Demo is coming soon – wishlist and follow Rune Ark on Steam now!

Join the community
Want more? Theories, support, secrets, memes, or chaos?
Join our Discord and become part of the darkness:
https://discord.gg/9YpyNz9vhk

notes.title: 🏹 Publisher Announcement – Rune Ark & indie.io! 🏹
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Rune Ark is officially joining forces with indie.io! ⚔️🕯️ This is a huge step for our project – a dark, medieval CRPG with magical elements and a deep, nonlinear story. Thanks to our partnership with indie.io, we can further develop our world full of mysteries, dark cults, and magic that comes at a price.  

---

🔥 About Rune Ark   
The world of Rune Ark is a place where magic is powerful, yet few understand its true nature. The protagonist, caught in conflicts between factions, uncovers their past and seeks their own path in a world filled with betrayals and dangers. This game is for those who enjoy:  

✔ Nonlinear storytelling – 40 different endings, all shaped by your choices.  
✔ Tactical combat and magic usage – a battle system based on match-3 mechanics, requiring strategic planning and mana management.  
✔ A dark fantasy world – inspired by medieval times and Lovecraftian mythology, full of mysteries and forgotten rituals.  

---

🤝 Why indie.io?   
While developing Rune Ark, we wanted to focus on creating a unique RPG experience rather than worrying about publishing logistics. indie.io helps us with promotion, reaching a wider audience, and managing the game’s Steam page. This allows us to dedicate ourselves to delivering the best version of **Rune Ark** to you!  

---

📜 What’s Next?   
This is just the beginning! You can:  

🔹 Add Rune Ark to your Steam wishlist! (📌 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3128940/Rune_Ark/)  
🔹 Follow us on social media to stay updated!  
🔹 Check out other amazing indie titles on indie.io’s publisher page! (🔗 Click here)  

Thank you for your support! Every comment, wishlist addition, and discussion helps us create an even better RPG. See you in the world of Rune Ark! ⚔️🔥
